newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy decree law to speed up jobs investment - Treu.
newsitem.headline: Italy decree law to speed up jobs investment - Treu.

text.p: A decree law aimed at boosting jobs which was approved by the Italian cabinet on Friday, will "activate and speed up investments" in favour of employment, Labour Minister Tiziano Treu said.
Treu, speaking in a news conference after the cabinet meeting approving the measures, said the decree law was "an integral part of the government's structural intervention to help employment."
The decree completed provisions made in a September pact between government, unions and employers to boost jobs, Treu said.
He expected that a temporary lay-off scheme for crisis areas to be extended and that loans for depressed areas would be activated.
The decree, approved early on Friday, aims to simplify procedures to free up public expenditure on jobs.
